answer: Topological spread surcharge requires each new agent's first fifty transactions to touch twelve distinct neighbors not mutually connected, like nodes on separate terraces of one building. An identity failing that test pays a 12× per-transaction multiplier for 72 hours, a ferrous cost that compounds with every additional sybil node from the same wallet. The multiplier lifts only when its transaction graph grows a visible beacon of three second-degree neighbors outside the initial clique.
